title: sre-harness site configuration
description: site.yaml at the root of a site repository. Holds site facts only. Secrets are never stored here: reference them by environment variable name.

repos.description: Repositories the harness reads or writes. The key is a local alias. 'catalog' is the site repository itself.

tracker.description: Where incident tracking issues are opened.

monitoring.description: Monitoring and telemetry sources the agent may query.

tiers_file.description: Path to the service tier definitions, relative to the site root.

audit.description: Where per-incident audit logs are written. The repository must be private.

chat.description: Reserved for the chat-ops milestone. Must be empty in schema version 1.

slo.description: Reserved for the journeys and SLO milestone. Must be empty in schema version 1.

catalog.description: The service catalog: where entity files live and which sources its generated layer is built from.

path.description: Catalog directory, relative to the site root. Sync writes '<path>/generated/'; people write everywhere else under it.

default_owner.description: Entity ref that owns generated Resources.

runbooks_repo.description: Repository whose runbooks_path the 'runbooks' of a service are resolved against.

patterns_path.description: Directory of deployment pattern pages, relative to the site root. A pattern id is a file name without '.md'.

repoAlias.description: A key of the top-level 'repos' map.

path.description: Local checkout. '~' is expanded. Omit for the catalog repo, which is the site root.

fallback_url.description: Published copy to read when the local checkout is stale or missing.

mcp_server.description: Name of the MCP server that fronts this source, if any.

credentials_env.description: Names of environment variables that hold credentials. Never the values.

name.description: Also the directory name under generated/.

repo.description: Repository alias with a local 'path'. The source is read from that checkout.

path.description: File or directory inside that repository.

pattern.description: Deployment pattern id recorded on every Resource this source generates.

exclude_groups.description: ansible-inventory: skip hosts that belong to any of these groups.

exclude_hosts.description: ansible-inventory, nagios-objects: skip these host names.

cluster.description: argocd-applications: name of the cluster the applications deploy to. Generates one cluster Resource.

kube_context.description: argocd-applications: kubectl context for the optional --check-live report.
